articles.title: The traditional 9-to-5 banking day is officially dying, says Morgan Stanley execs
articles.snippet: Tokenization and 24/7 markets are reshaping finance, making always-on banking a reality.

articles.title: The real reason DeFi projects that survived 2022 crash are shutting down now
articles.snippet: DeFi projects that survived the fallout from the Terra and FTX collapses in 2022 are dying out in 2026. But analysts say it’s not a case of industry consolidation — but the opposite.
